name: Amanogawa Kurouto
source:
Hobbies: Gardening.
[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D%C5%8Dbutsu_uranai]Zoological fortune-telling[/url]: Tiger.

Director of the Amanogawa Zoo and a veterinarian. Initially he had a dream of becoming a writer on the day he leaves the University of Tokyo, but on the same day his parents died. After that incident he decided to adopt and raise three daughters.
